tonight.headline: You beat the unbeaten by 2.24
body: Bad news first. Woody Marks is in the concussion protocol and DeMeco Ryans calls him unlikely for Thursday. Golden, Jacobs and the Rams D/ST are all on bye in Week 11, and Garrett Wilson's quarterback is having ankle tests. The Zvada-for-Gay kicker swap lost 2 to 8 and closed WRONG.
The game is over on both sides: 136.26 to 134.02 over a 9-0 team, pending stat corrections. You are 3-7. Nothing to set.

case.label: How it was won
case.body: Likely 27.7 and Tuten 20.3 carried it; Maye-day's Drake Maye left the Munich game with an ankle feared fractured and is out indefinitely (Yahoo 16 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A stat correction worth more than 2.24 points before ESPN finalises the week.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · archive · Yahoo Sports

whatWentWrong.title: Marks is unlikely for Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: Concussion in the third quarter; Ryans says there isn't time before Indianapolis.

case.label: What happened
case.body: 12 carries for 50 yards, then the protocol (archive; Athlon 16 Nov). An injury exit — not graded as a performance.

case.label: What it means
case.body: Your Week 11 backs are Taylor, Tuten and Gordon either way, so nothing needs doing. Montgomery is back to full practice; if he returns, Marks' thesis is tested on share when both are healthy.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Marks cleared by Wednesday with Montgomery still out.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker swap lost — and Gay is on waivers
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada 2, Gay 8. Do not reclaim Gay with priority that never resets.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Zvada was added on a projection that fell to 8.1 by kickoff; Thursday he scored 2, Gay 8 (archive).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap; 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — closed WRONG. The next kicker move only for a free agent with a real gap.

roster.footnote: Both sides are final. Result column: actuals and the gap to projection. Matchup tiles were not researched — the week is over. Odunze (bye) shows 0.0; Jacobs was out.

worthALook.name: Chargers D/ST
worthALook.lead: The free-agent defence with a Week 11 case — if the Jets start Klubnik.

case.label: The need
case.body: The Rams D/ST are on bye in Week 11. Bengals and 49ers D/ST are on waivers here, and STRATEGY §4 never spends IPADE priority on a streamer — so the answer is a free agent.

case.label: The case
case.body: The Jets visit Los Angeles; Klubnik threw for 137 yards with an interception and took three sacks in relief (NBC 16 Nov), and Geno Smith is having ankle tests.

case.label: Against it
case.body: No streaming column published today names the Chargers' defence, and they are winless (Ravens.com 16 Nov).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, with Week 11 projections in the file: add only if Smith is ruled out or no other free agent projects higher.
